content: SaaS dunning best practices: involuntary churn (failed cards, not intent) is 20-40% of all SaaS churn and mostly recoverable. Recommended retry pattern is 3-4 retries over 10-14 days, timed to paydays/bank settlement cycles rather than fixed intervals; decline-code-aware smart retries beat static schedules. Grace period before suspending access: 3-7 days commonly cited, 7-14 days for relationship preservation. First failure notification should go out within ~1 hour, then a spaced email + in-app sequence. Dunning is a distinct concern from access gating: the gateway retries, the app decides when to revoke.
